messages:
sarah-ops: seeing recurrent NCCL timeouts on a handful of us-west2 inference nodes after the kernel+driver bump.

anil-runtime: which nodes? can you paste the pod logs?

sarah-ops: gpool-a-12/13/14 — pattern: 100s of allgather timeouts when serving multi-GPU 8-shard reqs. logs show "NCCL WARN NET/Timeout" and then hangs.

mike-gpu: we rolled NCCL 2.12.13 last night, driver 525.85 -> 525.90, kernel 5.15.0-102 -> 5.15.0-104. Only affects nodes with mixed NICs (mellanox mlx5 + on-package nvlink), appears under >75% GPU util.

jun-ml: note: workloads with long KV cache hits exacerbate since sequences are bursty. suspect collective path + GDR read interplay.

sarah-ops: repro steps: run our inference smoke with --shards=8 --batch-split=4 for 10m at 90% concurrency. attached short log excerpt:

```
[2026-02-10 04:12:03] NCCL WARN NET/Timeout: 172.31.4.21: unable to recv header
[2026-02-10 04:12:07] NCCL ERR ALLGATHER: Timeout
[2026-02-10 04:12:07] Runtime: hang detected, killing job
```

anil-runtime: try setting NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=0 and NCCL_NET_GDR_READ=0 as a quick canary (disables GDR for read). If that stabilizes, it's a GDR-net interaction.

mike-gpu: toggled NCCL_NET_GDR_READ=0 on gpool-a-13 via env override -> no timeouts during a 20m stress run. interestingly, p2p still fine.

infra-bot: canary deploy started: gpool-a-13 env override NCCL_NET_GDR_READ=0 (user: anil-runtime)

deploy-bot: canary results: gpool-a-13 passed 20m smoke, gpool-a-12 still failing

jun-ml: suggests rolling back NCCL on subset or forcing net disable until we investigate driver/firmware.

sarah-ops: cost consideration: draining 4 nodes to rollback impacts capacity for low-latency tiers; recommend routing heavy multigpu traffic to dedicated reserved pools temporarily.

anil-runtime: plan: (1) disable GDR on net-heavy pools, (2) escalate to vendor with mlx5 firmware + driver logs, (3) run targeted nccl-tests to isolate allgather vs allreduce.

mike-gpu: also want to verify nv_peer_mem and CUDA IPC behaviour; add kernel boot arg "intel_iommu=on" not an option in cloud.

sarah-ops: opening incident ticket and tagging support@vendor, attaching kernel+driver configs + logs. will update.

anil-runtime: +1 — create canary for Dedicated only to avoid impacting hosted API. also add metric: "nccl.collective.timeouts" to SLO dashboard.

jun-ml: thanks. if vendor suggests patch, we'll run small canary with reduced shard count first.

sarah-ops: ok locking this thread, followups in incident#4321. :lock:
